meta.name: azure-kubernetes
meta.description: Plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters. Covers Day-0 checklist, SKU selection (Automatic vs Standard), networking options (private API server, Azure CNI Overlay, egress configuration), security, and operations (autoscaling, upgrade strategy, cost analysis). WHEN: create AKS environment, provision AKS, enable AKS observability, design AKS networking, choose AKS SKU, secure AKS, optimize AKS, AKS spot nodes, AKS cluster-autoscaler, rightsize AKS pod, pod rightsizing, over-provisioned AKS pod, pod resource requests and limits, Vertical Pod Autoscaler, VPA recommendations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划、创建并配置生产就绪的 AKS 集群。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正计划在 Azure 上搭建生产级 Kubernetes 集群。
copy.tagline_en: Plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes clusters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning to set up production-grade Kubernetes clusters on Azure.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会依据你的需求给出一套 AKS 集群配置建议：分清创建时定死、后期难改的初始决定（如网络、API 访问）和后期可开的功能，并覆盖网络、安全、监控、升级、成本等项，附带理由与操作命令。
howto.when: 当你说要创建或规划 AKS 集群，或提到设计网络、选择 SKU 等 AKS 配置话题时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个生产用的 AKS 集群，给出创建前必须定好的配置清单。
say.note: Claude 会输出 Day-0 决策清单和理由。

say.text: 集群里有些 pod 的 CPU 和内存请求设得过高，帮我做资源调整建议。
say.note: 会触发 Pod 资源调整参考，给出新的请求值建议。

howto.what_en: Claude will produce a recommended AKS configuration based on your needs, separating Day-0 decisions (networking, API server) from Day-1 features and covering security, observability, upgrades, and cost.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask to create or plan an AKS cluster, design its networking, or choose a SKU, and for other AKS topics like security or cost.

say_en.text: Help me plan a production AKS cluster with a checklist of decisions to fix before creation.
say_en.note: Claude will return the Day-0 checklist with recommendations.

say_en.text: Compare AKS Automatic and Standard SKUs and tell me which to pick.
say_en.note: Defaults to Automatic unless you need custom control.

say_en.text: Some pods have overly high CPU and memory requests. Give me resizing advice.
say_en.note: Triggers pod rightsizing reference for new request values.
